title: Campaign Knights: Taipei Street Campaign
heroTitle:
The city awaits
your next move.
heroBody: Lead your campaign knights through the capital. Spend your action points, navigate the streets, and break the opposition before the final day.
mission: Defeat every enemy unit within {{days}} turns.
missionDetail: Command a three-person Blue squad. Use class advantages, your commander’s shield, and field news to break the enemy line. Day and night share AP.
enterHint: Local single-player tactics · Progress stays in this page
endHint: Enemies move and attack when you end the night.
restartBody: Return to setup to choose your faction and commander. The saved campaign remains available until you confirm starting a new campaign.
mapSubtitle: Select a Blue unit, then a destination or an enemy outlined in red.

guideIntro: Select, move, attack. Make every action point count.
guide1: Select Blue units on the map or in the squad list.
guide2: Move to green tiles. Each path tile costs 1 AP. Barricades and units block movement.
guide3: Attack enemies outlined in red for 2 AP. Ranged units reach 3 tiles; cover does not block attacks.
guide4: AP carries from day into night. End the night for the enemy turn. Both squads recover AP the next morning.
guide5: Defeat all enemies before the end of day 28. Losing your squad or reaching the deadline ends the operation.
commanderRole: Heavy Lord · Your Blue Heavy Guard on the map
guardDescription: The commander takes no damage for 3 days, starting today. He cannot move, but can still attack.
eventQuietBody: No extra effects today. Watch for the next field dispatch.
eventBody_volunteers: Every surviving Blue unit gets 1 extra AP today. This is not repeated at night.
eventBody_rain: Movement costs 2 AP per tile for both teams today. Attack range is unchanged.
eventBody_spotlight: Both teams gain +5 base attack damage today, before class advantages.
counterBonus: Arrows point to the weaker class · +50% damage
logGuard: Jiang activates Capital Aegis: immune to damage for 3 days, but unable to move.
logAdvantage: {{team}} {{role}} exploited a class advantage for {{damage}} damage.
errorLeader: The commander has withdrawn. Skill unavailable.
errorCooldown: Capital Aegis is still on cooldown.
errorAnchored: The commander is holding Capital Aegis and cannot move while it is active.
guide6: Heavy beats Ranged, Ranged beats Scout, Scout beats Heavy. Advantages deal +50% damage. Red-outlined targets show predicted damage.
guide7: Capital Aegis costs the commander 2 AP. It grants immunity and prevents movement for 3 days, starting today; attacks remain available. Reuse after 6 days.
guide8: Fictional news events are drawn on odd days and last that day only. Even days have normal conditions. Changing language never redraws an event.
c_heroBody: Take your team into Taipei’s neighborhoods. Plan hex-grid routes, run community stages and contest landmark nodes. When the polls go dark, listen to the street.
c_mapTitle: From the corner to the city.

c_newsDesc_market: First visits draw a warmer response today. Daily crowd limits still apply.
c_newsDesc_volunteers: Each member of every faction receives one extra AP today, issued only in the morning.
c_newsDesc_clear: No extra movement costs today. Make the most of your routes and events.

c_buildHelp: 治疏嶼 takes two days to prepare; Cha-Cha Soapbox takes one. Staff the stage once open, then actively run events.
c_crowd: Ordinary visits today: {{count}}. Maximum two, with diminishing returns. Stage sessions have a separate limit.
c_transportHelp: Once per member daily for 6 AP and 4 materials. Arrive at the district anchor or a free neighboring hex in the same district, within the connected map.
c_actionHint: Activities settle at day end. Use polls or street reports to assess the campaign.
c_logStart: The campaign begins. All three factions’ commanders, speakers and street volunteers are ready.

c_logPoll: The day {{day}} poll is out, reflecting the previous night.

c_gameValues: Support and crowds are synthetic game data
c_guide1: Play 28 days, each with day and night. AP carries between phases. Your opponent acts at night’s end before settlement.
c_guide2: Select a district on the atlas, then enter the shared hex map. Changing views spends no time and never resets units.
c_guide3: New campaigns use 100 m road hexes. Select an empty hex to preview a road route, then confirm. AP rounds the full weighted route up per 100 m; stairs, rain and unadapted roadworks each add one section multiplier. Legacy campaigns retain 380 m hexes and original terrain costs.
c_guide4: Canvassing and visits cost 2 AP and 1 material, with two visits per node daily. Supplies gain 8 materials each morning. Fatigue reduces next-day AP; rest restores fatigue and mobilization.
c_guide5: Each member may charter once daily for 6 AP and 4 materials, gaining fatigue. Choose a destination district, then use the action panel.
c_guide6: Build either stage brand near a venue. After construction, assign a volunteer and actively run events, once per stage daily. Unstaffed stages earn nothing.
c_guide7: Hold a Wonder uncontested with a nearby team member and a local activity that day. Its special condition adds a bonus. Set priorities; at most three Wonders pay out daily.
c_guide8: Class counters: Iron Broker → Keyboard Wing → Grassblade → Iron Broker. Armor reduces loss, ranged units broadcast to an area, and scouts can flank. Depleted members return to base next morning.
c_guide9: Polls arrive on days 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12 and 14. Days 15–28 provide qualitative street reports. Presentations: days 7 and 21; debates: 14 and 27. After day 28’s final night, higher total support wins; equal totals draw. Actual scores unlock then.

c_skillDesc_jiang: Spend 2 AP for three days of mobilization immunity, starting today. Movement is locked; six-day cooldown.
c_skillDesc_shen: Spend 4 AP to disrupt rival rallies citywide through tomorrow. Rivals may still move and canvass. Create a local flank hotspot that settles once tonight. Six-day cooldown.
c_skillDesc_huang: Spend 3 AP to target a rival within three hexes and transfer up to 3 of their AP to your commander. A one-hex ceasefire zone around that rival lasts through tomorrow. Six-day cooldown.
c_trait_heavy: Armored: reduce incoming mobilization loss by 1. Brace for 2 more reduction, locking movement for the day. Counters ranged units at close range.
c_trait_ranged: Ranged: three-hex reach. Broadcast to the target and rivals in adjacent hexes; allies are unaffected. Counters scouts.
c_trait_scout: Scout: 18 daily AP. Reach one of the three adjacent directions behind a target’s facing arrow to backstab. Counters armored units.
c_facingHint: White arrows show facing. Approach from the opposite side for a rear flank.
c_noRivals: No eligible rivals are in range.
c_needRear: Move to an adjacent hex behind the target first.
c_targetGuarded: The target is protected by Capital Aegis.
c_errorRole: This class cannot use that tactic, or is already braced today.
c_errorRear: A rear flank requires a scout in an adjacent hex behind the target.
c_errorCeasefire: Signal disruption or a negotiation zone prevents this rally.
c_errorResponse: There is no available street event, or your team has already responded.
c_surpriseDuration: Fictional street event · Today only · One response per faction
c_surpriseDesc_heatwave: Ordinary activities here cause extra fatigue. Adapt to prevent the extra fatigue, or mobilize a volunteer for local momentum.
c_surpriseDesc_rumorstorm: Ordinary outreach here has a weaker response. Adapt to clear up confusion and remove the penalty, or mobilize a volunteer.
c_surpriseDesc_streetworks: Each hex here costs one extra AP to enter. Adapt to arrange alternate routing for your team and remove that cost.
c_surpriseDesc_nightfair: First ordinary visits here at night receive a stronger response. Adapt to organize extra outreach, or mobilize a volunteer.
c_surpriseDesc_donation: Adapt to coordinate the delivery and receive extra materials, or assign a volunteer to local outreach.
c_surpriseDesc_powercut: Stage sessions here cost one extra material and have a weaker response. Adapt to arrange backup power. Existing construction is preserved.
c_logSurge: The {{team}} Countercurrent hotspot settled at day end.
c_guide10: Choose Blue, Orange or White, then a fictional commander. Defaults are Jiang, Shen and Huang. Each faction has all three classes; the two opponents alternate who acts first each night. Commander cooldowns are six days.
c_guide11: Bracing costs 2 AP, adds 2 protection and locks movement today. Area broadcast costs 4 AP and 1 material, affecting the target and adjacent rivals. Rear flank costs 3 AP, requires an adjacent rear position, and adds its multiplier after the class counter but before protection.
c_guide12: Fictional October Surprises are drawn on odd days and expire the next morning. Adapt for 2 AP and 2 materials to remove your side’s penalty. Mobilize for 2 AP and reserve a volunteer until morning for local momentum. Delivery adaptation grants materials; night-fair adaptation boosts local response.
c_threeSides: Blue, Orange and White compete independently. The other two factions are computer-controlled. These are fictional game factions; choose your commander separately.
c_autoSaved: Progress is saved in this browser, automatically after each successful action and phase change.
c_autoSaveHint: Progress saves automatically once started. Continue using the same browser and address; clearing site data removes the save.
c_saveUnavailable: Local saving failed: storage may be blocked or full. You can keep playing; try Save now again later.
c_saveInvalid: The save is damaged or incomplete and cannot be resumed safely. It has been preserved; you may start a new campaign.
c_saveIncompatible: This save is incompatible with the current version. It has been preserved; you may start a new campaign.
c_overwriteBody: Starting a new campaign replaces this browser’s single campaign save. Cancel to keep and continue the saved campaign.
c_guide13: Poll shares include all three factions. After the final night of day 28, the highest citywide score wins; a tie for first is a draw. During blackout, only qualitative reports about the two front-runners appear.
c_guide14: Successful actions and phase changes save automatically; Save now is also available. Choose Continue campaign after returning home or reloading. Saves belong to this browser and address and are removed by clearing site data. Replacing a save requires confirmation.
c_mapReadingHelp: Hexagons are movement cells; buildings and planting are scenery; real roads have names and classes; round markers are activity locations.
c_trailHelp: Footprints: campaign arrivals. Solid cyan: this member’s walks today. Dashed gold: pending preview. Check: completed activity.
c_progressHelp: Only your faction’s records appear. Footprints include deployment, movement and charter arrivals. Checks mark locations where you held an activity. Counts are today’s ordinary activities, reset each morning; stage sessions are counted separately.
c_legacyTrail: This older save did not record earlier routes. Footprints continue from current positions; existing activity records are preserved.
c_guide15: The street map uses one aligned hex grid. Pale blue shows cells the selected member can reach; gold marks a pending route. Footprints record cells your faction reached; checks mark activity locations. The two-visit ordinary activity cap resets daily, while campaign progress remains saved.
c_planBudgetHelp: Estimates use the selected member and your resources. Choose one location at a time; other options update after each action.
c_noMatchingLocations: No locations match. Change the filter or selected member.
c_plan_travel: Move {{move}} AP + canvass {{ap}} AP: {{total}} AP / {{materials}} material total
c_plan_ap: Reaching this location and canvassing needs {{total}} AP; not enough AP remains.
c_plan_materials: Canvassing needs {{materials}} material; supplies are insufficient.
c_plan_capped: Today’s ordinary activity limit is reached. Return tomorrow.
c_plan_blocked: Outside the current reachable area. Change member, position or use a charter.
c_plan_locked: This member is holding position and cannot move there today.
c_todayWalkCount: Walks recorded for this member today: {{count}}. Numbers show their order.
c_noTodayWalk: No walks recorded for this member today. Deployment, charters and routes from earlier versions are not joined.
c_terrainCostHelp: Costs reflect this district, your adaptation and today’s weather. Water requires a passable bridge crossing. Route previews sum the actual costs of each entered hex.
c_guide16: The location list shows combined movement and canvassing costs. Move & canvass reserves the required resources; if resources or the visit limit prevent it, nothing is spent. Solid cyan lines show the selected member’s actual walks today in numbered order. Charters are not shown as walks.
c_sceneSchematic: Atlas artwork illustrates district character; sourced building footprints and elevation have separate map layers.
c_sceneBody_6300100: A market gateway, striped awnings and lanterns evoke the streets around Raohe Night Market.
c_sceneBody_6300200: Taipei 101’s stepped silhouette, glass towers, open plazas and street trees.
c_sceneBody_6300300: Forest Park canopies and paths meet low-rise homes, planted verges and benches.
c_sceneBody_6300400: The Fine Arts Museum’s offset volumes, geometric sculpture and planted corners.
c_sceneBody_6300500: The Memorial Hall roof, symmetrical colonnades and stepped public squares.
c_sceneBody_6300600: Wharf sails and ripples join brick gables and old-street arcades.
c_sceneBody_6300700: Lungshan Temple’s sweeping roofs, lanterns and courtyard steps among low-rise blocks.
c_sceneBody_6300800: A zoo-inspired gateway, hill contours, tea planting and hillside cottages.
c_sceneBody_6300900: The Music Center’s faceted profile inspires metal-clad blocks and layered plazas.
c_sceneBody_6301000: Bishanyan’s hilltop temple meets glass offices, green slopes and terraced contours.
c_sceneBody_6301100: Palace Museum rooflines, symmetrical courtyards and foothill planting.
c_sceneBody_6301200: Hot Spring Museum brickwork, pitched roofs and steam curls amid green slopes.
c_guide17: District atlases retain illustrative artwork. Map footprints come from OSM and are separate from optional illustrative scenery. Satellite DSM dates and limitations appear in the layer controls; elevations do not alter road AP.
c_roadsLoadFailed: Local road data could not be read. Hex actions remain available; retry to load the streets.
c_realRoadHelp: Geometry and names come from real road data; line widths are illustrative. Movement and AP still use 380 m hexes, not street-by-street walking navigation. Crossings may be grade-separated.
c_searchDistrictRoads: Find a local street ({{count}} named entries)
c_roadQueryPlaceholder: For example: 信義, 和平, 巷, 106
c_roadNameFallback: Street names retain their source spelling. This extract has no English-name field; no translations are invented.
c_noRoadResults: No matching street names in this class. Change the query or road class.
c_roadResultsLimited: Showing the first 12 entries. Type a name to narrow the results.
c_roadsInHex: Named roads in the selected / centered hex ({{count}})
c_roadHexHelp: Based on real lines intersecting the full hex. A road does not make the hex passable or count as a recorded visit.
c_noNamedRoadsInHex: No named road is recorded in this hex; unnamed paths may still exist.
c_guide18: The road basemap provides source names, classes and search. Lavender locates a road and does not establish walkability; gold previews and cyan records game routes. Bridges, tunnels and overpasses follow OSM node references. Geometric crossings do not create junctions. Missing English names fall back to the original name.
c_streetProfile: Road tactics | 100 m hex diameter · source road routing
c_legacyProfile: Legacy campaign | 380 m hex diameter · original rules and positions
c_assumedWalk: Some sections have no foot-access tag and are assumed walkable by game policy.
c_roadMapReading: One 100 m hex grid; units use fixed road anchors. Buildings use OSM footprints; the satellite DSM shows the surface. Gold previews routes and cyan records walks. Illustrative scenery has a separate toggle.
c_streetRoadHelp: New campaigns follow source road nodes; crossing lines do not automatically connect. Expressways and explicitly restricted sections are excluded. Ordinary roads with missing foot tags use a game assumption. This is not real-world navigation. Legacy campaigns retain their grid.
c_roadAPHelp: Road AP = total weighted metres / 100, rounded up; any move costs at least 1 AP. Stairs, rain and unadapted roadworks each add one to the affected section’s multiplier. Illustrated slopes add no cost. Water crossings require source road connections; charter travel is separate.
c_roadRain: Rain adds one to the road AP distance multiplier; day and night share AP.
c_roadWorks: Fictional event: road sections in this district gain one AP distance multiplier. Adapt to remove your faction’s penalty.
c_guide19: New campaigns use road mode. Legacy saves preserve positions, AP and history without map migration. New saves record a road revision and reject mismatches. This offline tactics model assumes access on ordinary roads with missing foot tags; it is not surveyed navigation or a guarantee of real access.
c_roadMapAttribution: Routes follow source topology; scenery and ordinary stops are game designs. Sources:
c_buildingsFailed: Building data could not load; roads and actions remain available.
c_surfaceFailed: Elevation data could not load; roads and actions remain available.
c_surfaceModelNote: Copernicus GLO-30 is a surface model (DSM), including roofs, infrastructure and tree canopy. Main acquisition: 2011–2015; this is the 2021 public release, with possible older gap-filling. It is not a bare-earth or road survey and does not change AP.
c_surfaceAtAnchor: Surface elevation at the selected road anchor / hex centre
c_surfaceDatum: EGM2008 vertical datum · resampled 30 m grid; decimals do not imply survey accuracy
c_buildingsInCell: Buildings intersecting this hex ({{count}} source footprints)
c_buildingCoverage: Queries individual source footprints and preserves courtyard holes. OSM does not cover every real building. Blank areas are not filled with invented buildings; source names and heights may also be missing.
c_buildingsLimited: The list shows 12 entries; all visible source footprints remain on the map.
c_buildingHeight: Source-tagged height (not surveyed by this game)
c_buildingSourceNote: Individual footprints come from the 2026-10-29 OSM / Geofabrik PBF, clipped to the original official city boundary and projected to EPSG:3826. Heights and storeys use interpretable source tags only, without estimation. This is not cadastral or complete surveyed building coverage.
c_surfaceSourceNote: GLO-30 has nominal ~30 m (1 arc-second) native spacing and is satellite-derived. The local subset is bilinearly reprojected to a 30 m grid. Hillshade and 50 m contours describe the surface, not precise differences between pavements, buildings or trees.
c_geoLicence: Source licences and derived data downloads
c_surfaceProfile: Satellite surface route profile (not road elevation)
c_surfaceProfileHelp: The profile includes roofs and canopy. It informs landscape reading and adds no uphill or downhill AP.
c_surfaceProfileGaps: The profile includes roofs and canopy. Missing data creates gaps, without invented elevations or AP changes.
c_surfaceRouteMissing: No surface elevation is available for this route.
c_guide20: Building footprints follow OSM geometry, retaining courtyard holes. Select a hex and inspect source height, storeys and IDs; missing values remain unknown. The ~30 m GLO-30 surface (main acquisition 2011–2015, 2021 release) includes roofs and canopy, with hillshade, 50 m contours and route profiles. It is not bare-earth or surveyed road elevation and does not affect AP. Existing saves and tactical rules remain compatible.
